zh-CN.page_title: option-berth · Git worktree 的本地服务运行引擎
zh-CN.description: oberth 是 Git worktree 的本地服务运行引擎。每个 checkout 有一个 Runtime World：清单、运行注册表、系统观察和因果诊断；原生 Attention 把失败和过期代码交给人和 coding agent。
zh-CN.hero_title: Git worktree 的本地服务运行引擎
zh-CN.hero_lede: oberth 给每个 checkout 一个独立的 Runtime World：清单描述意图，运行注册表记录执行，操作系统观察给出事实，因果诊断把级联失败收敛成一个根因。原生 Attention 把确切的失败服务和过期二进制交给人和 coding agent，赶在下一轮操作之前。
zh-CN.hero_meta: 本地优先 · 单二进制 · MIT
zh-CN.hero_world_note: 四个位置各有唯一写入者；后面的位置只读前面的结果。
zh-CN.hero_intent_note: 这个 checkout 应该跑什么，在哪个端口，依赖谁。
zh-CN.hero_execution_note: 启动顺序、实际地址、退出码和日志路径。
zh-CN.hero_observation_note: 进程、监听、健康、退出：四项独立事实。
zh-CN.hero_diagnosis_note: 级联失败收敛成根因，保留脱敏后的 first_error。
zh-CN.wb_lede: 两个 worktree、四种真实故障状态。Human 视图读运行事实，--json 视图读同一份契约。
zh-CN.wb_caption: 状态取自评审夹具；页面不连接 runtime service。
zh-CN.wb_healthy_diag_body: 观察到 4 个服务 · 0 个被阻塞 · 0 个过期。
zh-CN.wb_healthy_attn: 没有待处理的 Attention note。
zh-CN.wb_cascade_title: auth 崩溃，api 与 gateway 被挡住。
zh-CN.wb_cascade_diag_title: auth 在 12:04:17 以退出码 1 结束。
zh-CN.wb_cascade_diag_body: first_error 指向 postgres:5432 的连接被拒绝（已脱敏）。api 和 gateway 收敛为 blocked_by_dep。
zh-CN.wb_port_diag_body: port_holder 是 worktree main 的 pid 44120。oberth 只报告持有者，不会杀掉另一个 checkout 的进程。
zh-CN.wb_port_diag_body_main: port_holder 是 worktree feat/billing 的 pid 44120。oberth 只报告持有者，不会杀掉另一个 checkout 的进程。
zh-CN.wb_drift_title: web 还在跑三次修改之前的二进制。
zh-CN.wb_drift_diag_title: code_stale：12:01:08 启动，源码在 12:03:44 改变。
zh-CN.wb_drift_diag_body: 运行中的进程和当前工作树不一致。下一次测试之前需要重启。
zh-CN.core_lede: 每个 checkout 的运行被拆成四个不可互换的位置。写入边界固定，后面的位置只读前面的结果。
zh-CN.core_intent_desc: 清单声明服务、端口、依赖和健康检查。由人确认；模型只能起草。
zh-CN.core_execution_desc: 一次启动的依赖顺序、实际地址、退出码和日志路径。运行注册表是唯一写入者。
zh-CN.core_observation_desc: 进程、监听、健康和退出是四项独立事实。读不到就是 unknown，不是没有。
zh-CN.core_diagnosis_desc: 把依赖链上的多个失败收敛成根因，并保留脱敏后的 first_error。
zh-CN.core_collapse_title: 级联失败只留一个根因。
zh-CN.core_collapse_body: auth 崩溃时，api 与 gateway 只是 blocked_by_dep。诊断保留 1 个根因、2 个受阻下游服务（api、gateway），不把下游失败当成同等原因。
zh-CN.core_loop_title: 重复崩溃不会被当成健康。
zh-CN.core_loop_body: 启动时间、退出码和日志指纹一起识别 crash/restart loop；第 8 次重启仍然会带着证据报告。
zh-CN.attn_lede: Attention 是引擎内部的确定性观察层。运行事实生成可复核的 note；启用 triage 后才调用模型。
zh-CN.attn_always_body: 每次 runtime 观察都会生成 Attention Notes：端口冲突的持有者、过期代码、上游崩溃。每条 note 带严重度、证据和一条可执行命令。
zh-CN.attn_triage_body: strict 只报告只读事实；assist 在证据足够时给出下一步命令；reconcile 在显式开启后，只对归属当前 worktree 的声明服务做有界恢复建议，永不触碰外部进程、machine: 依赖或清单。
zh-CN.attn_delivery_title: 在 PostToolUse 返回时送达
zh-CN.attn_delivery_body: 开启 agent hook 后，Attention 在工具调用返回时把 note 递送给 coding agent，不必等到下一轮才看到。适配器支持 Decisions API、OpenAI 和 Anthropic。
zh-CN.attn_mode_strict_note: 只报告只读事实与证据，不推荐变更动作。
zh-CN.attn_mode_assist_note: 证据足够时给出确切命令，例如 oberth restart --only web。
zh-CN.attn_mode_reconcile_note: 显式开启后，仅对当前 worktree 归属的过期或崩溃服务做有界恢复，永不杀外部进程或改清单。
zh-CN.attn_case_body: auth 在 12:04:17 以退出码 1 结束。api 和 gateway 被阻塞；first_error 指向 postgres:5432 的连接被拒绝。
zh-CN.proof_intro: $proof_run_count 次真实运行：$proof_scenario_count 个十服务栈场景 × 2 种方式 × $proof_repeat 次重复，同一 agent、同一模型、同一二进制。左列带 oberth，右列只用 agent。
zh-CN.proof_caption: 真实 agent 运行结果对比
zh-CN.proof_result: $proof_scenarios_fewer/$proof_comparable_scenarios 场景轮次更少；越界操作 $proof_oob_with/$proof_oob_without。
zh-CN.proof_note: 测量于 $proof_measured_date。单一 agent、单一模型、内部夹具；每格 $proof_repeat 次，P95 只作方向性证据。
zh-CN.proof_bar_note: 每根条按同一指标的最大值归一。完成数越高越好；轮次与用时越低越好。
zh-CN.commands_intro: 人读 Human 输出，agent 读 --json；两者都来自同一条运行链。
zh-CN.command_empty: 没有匹配的命令。清空输入查看全部。
zh-CN.cmd_runtime_desc: 读一个 checkout 的 Runtime World：服务、运行、观察和根因。
zh-CN.cmd_status_desc: 现在是什么状态：声明、运行、端口和最近一次退出。
zh-CN.cmd_up_desc: 按 depends_on 顺序启动服务，并等待实际就绪。
zh-CN.cmd_logs_desc: 回到失败现场，读服务自己的输出和第一条错误。
zh-CN.cmd_down_desc: 只停这个 worktree 的项目服务，不动另一个 checkout。
zh-CN.cmd_attn_desc: 查看或启用 Attention：note、triage 模式和 consent 状态。
zh-CN.cmd_workplace_desc: 把这份 checkout 做过的命令与任务留给下一个会话。
zh-CN.cmd_doctor_desc: 检查环境、清单和观察条件，不把未知当成成功。
zh-CN.manifest_note: 清单由人确认，是 Runtime World 的输入。port: auto 由引擎按运行预留。
zh-CN.install_intro: 用安装脚本取最新发布，或从源码构建。安装器只写二进制，不启动服务。
zh-CN.install_release_body: 脚本解析最新发布，按平台下载并核对 SHA256，装到 ~/.local/bin。固定版本加 --version。
zh-CN.install_release_windows: Windows 用 PowerShell：irm .../install.ps1 | iex。完整服务场景在 macOS/Linux 验证；Windows 是独立原生构建与冒烟。
zh-CN.install_source_body: 需要 Go 与 mage。mage buildEngine 只写入 ./bin，不改 PATH，也不安装服务。
zh-CN.install_note: mage install 会写入安装目录并修改 PATH。构建本身不安装任何东西。
zh-CN.faq_a1: 没有。引擎只提供 CLI；Human 输出和 --json 都来自同一条命令。
zh-CN.faq_q2: 会接管整台机器的端口吗？
zh-CN.faq_a2: 不会。它只回答当前 worktree 声明的服务；machine: 依赖只读，起停不碰它们。端口冲突只报告持有者。
zh-CN.faq_a3: 产品的 Git 操作只读。清单由人确认，agent 可以起草，但不能代替你采纳。
zh-CN.faq_q4: 没有端口就是没在运行吗？
zh-CN.faq_a4: 不是。无端口 worker 通过运行记录观察；进程、监听、健康和退出是分开的事实。
zh-CN.faq_a5: 有原生构建、冒烟和部分事实/持久化检查；完整服务场景只在 macOS/Linux 验证。
zh-CN.faq_q6: 需要模型账号或云端吗？
zh-CN.faq_a6: 不需要。引擎本地运行，不内置模型推理，也没有云端同步。Attention 是可选启用。
zh-CN.faq_q7: 怎么让 coding agent 学会用它？
zh-CN.faq_a7: skill 是独立仓库，用 npx skills add SheathedSharp/option-berth-skill -g 装到本机已安装的 agent；Claude Code 也可走插件市场。引擎不会替你装。
zh-CN.faq_q8: 能和 Conductor、Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 一起用吗？
zh-CN.faq_a8: 能。在它们自己的 setup / cleanup 脚本或外层 wrapper 里调用 oberth；引擎不安装 hooks、不改它们的配置。配方见页脚“接入工具”。
zh-CN.cta_body: 引擎与 coding agent skill 各自发版，共用同一条运行链。

en.page_title: option-berth · a deterministic runtime engine for worktrees
en.description: oberth is a deterministic runtime engine for Git worktrees. Every checkout gets a Runtime World: manifest intent, a run registry, live OS observation and causal diagnosis; native Attention hands failures and stale code to people and coding agents.
en.hero_title: A deterministic runtime engine for multi-worktree development
en.hero_lede: oberth gives every checkout its own Runtime World: a manifest for intent, a run registry for execution, live OS observation, and a causal diagnosis that collapses cascading failures into one root cause. A native Attention engine puts the exact failing service or stale binary in front of a human or a coding agent before the next turn.
en.hero_world_note: Each position has one writer; later positions read only what earlier ones published.
en.hero_intent_note: What this checkout should run, on which port, after which dependency.
en.hero_execution_note: Start order, actual address, exit code and log path.
en.hero_observation_note: Process, listener, health and exit are four separate facts.
en.hero_diagnosis_note: Cascading failures collapse to one root cause, with a redacted first_error.
en.wb_lede: Two worktrees, four real fault states. The Human view reads runtime facts; --json reads the same contract.
en.wb_caption: Worked states from the evaluation fixtures. The page never contacts a runtime service.
en.wb_cascade_title: auth crashed; api and gateway are blocked.
en.wb_cascade_diag_body: first_error points at a refused connection to postgres:5432 (redacted). api and gateway collapse into blocked_by_dep.
en.wb_port_diag_body: port_holder is worktree main, pid 44120. oberth reports the holder; it does not kill another checkout's process.
en.wb_port_diag_body_main: port_holder is worktree feat/billing, pid 44120. oberth reports the holder; it does not kill another checkout's process.
en.wb_drift_title: web is serving the binary from before three edits.
en.wb_drift_diag_body: The running process does not match the tree. Restart before the next test.
en.core_lede: Each checkout's runtime is split into four positions that never substitute for one another. Each position has one writer, and later positions read only what earlier ones published.
en.core_intent_desc: The manifest declares services, ports, dependencies and health checks. A person confirms it; a model may only draft it.
en.core_execution_desc: Dependency order, actual address, exit code and log path for one start. The run registry is the only writer.
en.core_observation_desc: Process, listener, health and exit are four independent facts. An unread fact is unknown, not absent.
en.core_diagnosis_desc: Multiple failures on a dependency chain collapse into one root cause, with a redacted first_error.
en.core_collapse_title: A cascade leaves one root cause.
en.core_collapse_body: When auth crashes, api and gateway are only blocked_by_dep. Diagnosis keeps 1 root cause and 2 impacted downstream services (api, gateway) instead of treating downstream failures as equal causes.
en.core_loop_title: A restart loop is not a healthy service.
en.core_loop_body: Start time, exit code and log fingerprint identify a crash/restart loop; the eighth restart still arrives with evidence.
en.attn_lede: Attention is deterministic observation inside the engine. Runtime facts produce reviewable notes; triage calls a model only after you enable it.
en.attn_always_body: Every runtime observation produces Attention Notes: the holder of a port conflict, stale code, an upstream crash. Each note carries severity, evidence and one executable command.
en.attn_triage_body: strict reports read-only facts; assist recommends the next command when evidence supports it; reconcile opts into bounded recovery for declared services owned by this worktree—never killing foreign processes or touching machine: or oberth.yaml.
en.attn_delivery_body: With an agent hook enabled, Attention delivers the note when a tool call returns, so the agent does not wait for the next turn. The adapter supports the Decisions API, OpenAI and Anthropic.
en.attn_mode_strict_note: Read-only facts and evidence without recommending mutations.
en.attn_mode_assist_note: Give the exact command when the evidence supports it, such as oberth restart --only web.
en.attn_mode_reconcile_note: Opt-in bounded recovery for declared stale or crashed owned services; never touches foreign processes or oberth.yaml.
en.attn_case_body: auth exited 1 at 12:04:17. api and gateway are blocked; first_error points at a refused connection to postgres:5432.
en.proof_intro: $proof_run_count real runs: $proof_scenario_count ten-service stacks × 2 setups × $proof_repeat repeats, one agent, one model, one binary. The left column is with oberth; the right column is the agent alone.
en.proof_result: $proof_scenarios_fewer/$proof_comparable_scenarios scenarios needed fewer turns; out-of-bounds moves: $proof_oob_with/$proof_oob_without.
en.proof_note: Measured $proof_measured_date. One agent, one model, internal fixtures. Each cell is $proof_repeat runs, so p95 is directional.
en.proof_bar_note: Each bar is normalized to the larger value in its metric. More completions is better; fewer turns and less time is better.
en.commands_intro: People read Human output; agents read --json. Both come from the same runtime chain.
en.command_empty: No matching command. Clear the field to see them all.
en.cmd_runtime_desc: Read one checkout's Runtime World: services, runs, observation and root causes.
en.cmd_status_desc: What is true now: declaration, runtime, ports and the last exit.
en.cmd_up_desc: Start services in depends_on order and wait for real readiness.
en.cmd_logs_desc: Return to the failure scene and read the service's own output and first error.
en.cmd_down_desc: Stop only this worktree's services, without touching another checkout.
en.cmd_attn_desc: Inspect or enable Attention: notes, triage mode and consent state.
en.cmd_workplace_desc: Keep the commands and tasks from this checkout for the next session.
en.cmd_doctor_desc: Check the environment, manifest and observation conditions without calling unknown a success.
en.manifest_note: A person confirms the manifest; it is the input to the Runtime World. port: auto is reserved per run by the engine.
en.install_intro: Use the install script for the latest release, or build from source. The installer writes a binary and starts no service.
en.install_release_body: The script resolves the latest release, downloads the archive for this platform, verifies SHA256, and installs into ~/.local/bin. Pin a version with --version.
en.install_release_windows: On Windows use PowerShell: irm .../install.ps1 | iex. Full service scenarios are verified on macOS/Linux; Windows has a native build and smoke checks.
en.install_source_body: Needs Go and mage. mage buildEngine writes only ./bin; it changes no PATH and installs no service.
en.install_note: mage install writes to the install directory and changes PATH. Building alone installs nothing.
en.faq_q1: Does it have a graphical interface?
en.faq_a1: No. The engine ships a CLI; Human output and --json both come from the same command.
en.faq_q2: Does it take over every port on the machine?
en.faq_a2: No. It answers only for the current worktree's declared services. machine: dependencies stay read-only, and a port conflict reports the holder instead of killing it.
en.faq_q3: Does it write to my Git repository?
en.faq_a3: Product Git actions are read-only. A person confirms the manifest; an agent may draft it but cannot adopt it for you.
en.faq_q4: Does no port mean it is not running?
en.faq_a4: No. A portless worker is observed through its run record. Process, listener, health and exit are separate facts.
en.faq_a5: There are native builds, smoke tests and some fact/persistence checks. Full service scenarios are verified only on macOS/Linux.
en.faq_q6: Does it need a model account or the cloud?
en.faq_a6: No. The engine runs locally, contains no model inference and has no cloud sync. Attention is opt-in.
en.faq_q7: How does a coding agent learn to use it?
en.faq_a7: The skill is a separate repository. Install it for the agents already on your machine with npx skills add SheathedSharp/option-berth-skill -g, or through the Claude Code plugin marketplace. The engine does not install it for you.
en.faq_q8: Can I use it with Conductor, Cursor, Claude Code or Codex?
en.faq_a8: Yes. Call oberth from their own setup/cleanup scripts or an outer wrapper. The engine installs no hooks and edits none of their configuration. Recipes are linked in the footer under Integrations.
en.cta_body: The engine and the coding-agent skill release on their own schedules and share one runtime chain.
